pages.title: Chocolate, Tea and Coffee
pages.text:
Two addons turn Create into a sweet shop and a cafe.

- **Create Confectionery** handles chocolate, candy and gingerbread.
- **Create Cafe** handles coffee, tea and syrups.

Both lean on Create's [#](7A3C9A)[mixing](entry://glossary/mixing)[#](), filling and [#](7A3C9A)[compacting](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]().

pages.title: Confectionery
pages.text: Chocolate comes in milk, dark, white and ruby as fluids. Compact it into bars or build with chocolate bricks. Also candy, caramel, marshmallow and gingerbread.

pages.title: More sweets
pages.text:
Candy cane tools, a Gingerbread Man mob and hot chocolate drinks round out Confectionery. White, dark and hot chocolate use [#](2E5AAC)[Ratatouille](entry://food/ratatouille)[#]()'s cocoa butter and powder.\
\
Look recipes up in [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#]() with **R**.

pages.title: Coffee
pages.text: Coffee fruit is crushed to beans, roasted in a smoker, then milled or crushed to grounds. Syrups flavour drinks, applied with a Spout.

pages.title: Tea and Syrups
pages.text: Mixed over heat from fruit, melted sugar and often milk or water. Fruit from Fruits Delight, Berries and Cherries, Twilight Forest and Northstar all count.

The mixing recipes need a **Blaze Burner** under the mixer. Tapioca flour, oreo and crushed cookies give bubble tea style toppings.\
\
Blood Oranges come from [#](7A3C9A)[haunting](entry://glossary/haunting)[#]() an orange with a Fan. Mana Berries come from filling sweet berries with 25 [#](7A3C9A)[mB](entry://glossary/mb)[#]() of liquid experience in a Spout.
